models_evaluated: Epic End of Life Care Index (EOLCI)
academic machine learning mortality model for cancer patients

links.outcome: Local AUC of vendor EOLCI for 1-year mortality versus vendor-stated AUC
links.effect: EOLCI AUC 0.73 (95% CI 0.70-0.76) vs vendor-stated 0.86; academic model AUC 0.82 (0.80-0.85). PPV 0.38 vs 0.65.
links.quote: The EOLCI's discrimination performance was lower than the vendor-stated value (AUC of 0.86) and the academic model's performance.

links.outcome: Vendor model compared against academic model on same patients for 1-year mortality AUC and PPV
links.effect: AUC 0.73 (EOLCI) vs 0.82 (academic); PPV 0.38 vs 0.65, showing the vendor model performed worse than the comparator.
links.quote: AUC for 1-year mortality for EOLCI and academic model was 0.73 (95% CI [0.70-0.76]) and 0.82 (95% CI [0.80-0.85]), respectively.

screen.reason: Retrospective evaluation and independent validation of a widely deployed proprietary vendor model (Epic EOLCI) compared against a specialized academic model in a cancer subpopulation.

primary.practice: local validation of commercial vendor model
